text:
Maya R: Heads-up — noticing a sharp drop in prefix cache hit-rate for model=redwood-open-7b on route=/chat/stream since ~02:55 UTC. Top tenants tokens_saved down ~40%. Anyone looking at this?
Alex C: saw that too, spotted a kernel-selection change in the rollout at 02:52 that switched some hosts to fast_gemm_v2. Could be a side-effect on key hashing or padding.
Jun L: link to grafana?
Maya R: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/prefix_hits/prefix-hitboard?from=now-6h&to=now — look at the per-tenant tokens_saved panel and the per-model hit-rate heatmap.
ops-bot: Alert: prefix_cache_tokens_saved_drop (threshold: -30%) triggered for cluster=prod-eu, affected_tenants=5
Alex C: quick SQL I ran to roll up the signal:
```sql
SELECT tenant, model, route, sum(tokens_saved) as saved, avg(hit_rate) as hr
FROM metrics.prefix_cache
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '6 hours'
GROUP BY tenant, model, route
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Maya R: output highlights AcmeCorp dropped from 31.2M -> 11.9M tokens_saved (hr 0.62 -> 0.24). Other tenants similar pattern.
Jun L: I wonder if cache key normalization/regression from the key-normalizer PR collided with the new kernel padding change. I saw a small change in prefix fingerprinting rounding earlier this week.
Alex C: timeline: 02:45 deploy of key-normalizer fallback, 02:52 kernel rollout. Hypothesis: normalized key prefix length interacts with batching heuristics -> lower contiguous cache hits.
Maya R: can we validate by slicing hit-rate by key-length and batching window?
Alex C: yes, I added a short prometheus query: `sum by (key_len) (rate(prefix_cache_hits[5m])) / sum by (key_len) (rate(prefix_cache_requests[5m]))` — initial eyeball shows big drop for key_len in [64,128].
Jun L: also seeing KV-cache GC increased item churn around 02:58 on some hosts (gc_count spiked). Could be eviction pressure because of different KV footprint after kernel change.
Maya R: action items: 1) rollback kernel rollouts for affected hosts (canary) 2) enable extra prefix-key sampling for the next 30m and log raw key fingerprints 3) add temporary grafana panel showing key_len hit_rate by tenant
Alex C: rolling back ~20% of pods in prod-eu now (canary tag -> stable_kernels). will monitor. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by Alex C: rollout_id=rl-2026-03-18-002, affected_hosts=12
Maya R: Jun, can you enable sampling config (0.02) to capture raw user prompts for impacted tenants (PII-safe hashing) and ship to s3/test-prefix-dumps? snippet: 
```json
{
  "sampling": 0.02,
  "masking": "sha256-hex",
  "fields": ["model","route","tenant","prefix_fingerprint","key_len"]
}
```
Jun L: done. started sampling, uploading to s3://prefix-dumps/2211112222-samples.json.gz
Maya R: nice. If rollback restores hit-rate, suspect kernel/batching interplay. If not, key-normalizer change is likely root.
Alex C: monitoring saved tokens and hit-rate per-tenant; will report back in 15m.
Maya R: thanks. tagging eng-runtime-watchlist. :thumbsup:
